weaponMasteries.cleave: Once per turn after hitting with a melee attack, make an attack with the same weapon against another creature within 5 feet of the first and within your reach. On a hit, deal the weapon's damage without a positive ability modifier.
weaponMasteries.graze: On a miss, deal damage of the weapon's type equal to the ability modifier used for the attack. Only an increase to that modifier can increase this damage.
weaponMasteries.nick: Make the extra Light-property attack as part of the Attack action instead of a Bonus Action, once per turn.
weaponMasteries.push: On a hit, push a Large or smaller creature up to 10 feet straight away from you.
weaponMasteries.sap: On a hit, the target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
weaponMasteries.slow: On a damaging hit, reduce the target's Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Multiple Slow hits do not increase the reduction.
weaponMasteries.topple: On a hit, the target makes a Constitution save against DC 8 + the attack's ability modifier + your Proficiency Bonus; on a failure, it is Prone.
weaponMasteries.vex: On a damaging hit, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.
